title: Update the automatic message for a TikTok account
content_data:
Use this endpoint to update an automatic message for a TikTok account. After you update an automatic message, use [/business/message/auto_message/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184619749377) to verify the status of the message. ## Before you start - Because of the sensitive nature of direct message data, TikTok has implemented a higher level of due diligence for developers that will process automatic messages on behalf of TikTok account users. Ensure that you [have completed the necessary data security and privacy reviews and obtained access to Business Messaging API](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/access-to-business-messaging-api/v1.3) before calling this endpoint. - Ensure the TikTok account is a TikTok Account with Advanced Access or Verified Business Account. Learn more [about TikTok account entitlements](https://ads.tiktok.com/resources/help/article/about-tiktok-account-entitlements). To confirm this, use [/business/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs/get-profile-data-of-a-tiktok-account/v1.3) and check whether the response parameter `has_advanced_access` is `true` for the TikTok account. - Ensure the TikTok account owner is over 18 years old. ## Request **Endpoint** https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/message/auto_message/update/ **Method** POST **Header** ```xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |Access-Token {Required}|string|A short-term access token authorized by the TikTok account owner.
For details, see [Authentication](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184175482945).| |Content-Type {Required}|string|Request message type.
Allowed format: `application/json`. | ``` **Parameters** ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Data Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |--- |--- |--- | | business_id {Required}| string | Application specific unique identifier for the TikTok account.

Pass the value of the `open_id` field returned in the response of [/tt_user/oauth2/token/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184175482945#item-link-Obtain%20a%20short-term%20access%20token) to this field. | | auto_message_id {Required}| string | The ID of the automatic message.

To retrieve the automatic messages for a TikTok account, use [/business/message/auto_message/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184619749377).| | auto_message_type{Required} | string | The type of automatic message.

Enum values:
  • `WELCOME_MESSAGE`: welcome message. A welcome message is a message that is automatically sent to a user when they start a direct message conversation with you.
  • `SUGGESTED_QUESTION`: suggested question. A suggested question is a frequently asked question displayed at the beginning of a chat. When the user selects a suggested question, the user will automatically receive the corresponding preset answer.
  • `CHAT_PROMPT`: chat prompt. A chat prompt is an interactive button displayed above the input box. When users tap a chat prompt, the system will automatically generate a corresponding question for users to start the conversation.
  • `FOLLOW_WELCOME`: new follower message. A new follower message is a message that is automatically sent to a user when they follow you. This message is sent to new followers once a day and may be briefly delayed for a more natural experience.

Note: An automatic message that is pending review cannot be updated. To check the review status of an automatic message, use [/business/message/auto_message/get/](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1832184619749377) and ensure the returned `audit_status` for the automatic message is not `REVIEWING`. | | welcome_message {+Conditional} | object | Required when `auto_message_type` is `WELCOME_MESSAGE`.

Information about the welcome message. | #| content{+Conditional} | string | Required when `welcome_message` is passed.

The text of the welcome message.

Example: `Hi there, Please leave us a message and we will respond to you shortly. Thank you!`. | | suggested_question {+Conditional} | object | Required when `auto_message_type` is `SUGGESTED_QUESTION`.

Information about the suggested question.

You can only update one suggested question per call.
To update multiple suggested questions, call `/business/message/auto_message/update/` multiple times. | #| question{+Conditional} | string | Required when `suggested_question` is passed.

A frequently asked question to help users start a conversation.

Length limit: 80 characters. | #| answer{+Conditional} | string | Required when `suggested_question` is passed.

The preset answer that will be automatically sent when a user selects the question.

Length limit: 200 characters. | | chat_prompt {+Conditional} | object | Required when `auto_message_type` is `CHAT_PROMPT`.

Information about the chat prompt. | #| title{+Conditional} | string | Required when `chat_prompt` is passed.

The name of the prompt button that is displayed above the input box.

Length limit: 18 characters.

You can use text, system emojis, and both English and non-English languages.

To ensure optimal display, keep the name concise and clear. | #| content {+Conditional} | string | Required when `chat_prompt` is passed.

The corresponding question for the prompt that the system automatically generates for users to start the conversation when users tap the chat prompt.

Length limit: 150 characters.

You can use text, system emojis, and both English and non-English languages. | |follow_welcome {+Conditional}|object|Required when `auto_message_type` is `FOLLOW_WELCOME`.

The configuration details for the new follower message.| #|message {+Conditional}|string|Required when `follow_welcome` is specified.

The text of the new follower message.

You can use `{s_nickname}` as a placeholder for the follower's name. For example, if you configure the message as "Hi {`s_nickname`}, thanks for following!", a follower named "John" receives "Hi John, thanks for following!"

Length limit: 500 characters.| #|interaction {+Conditional}|string|Required when `follow_welcome` is specified.

The way that followers can interact with the new follower message.

Enum values:

  • `NONE`: None.
  • `QUICK_REPLY`: quick reply. You need to specify `quick_reply_text` simultaneously.
  • `QUICK_ACTION`: quick action. You need to specify `quick_action_type` simultaneously.
| #|quick_reply_text {+Conditional}|string|Required when `interaction` is `QUICK_REPLY`.

The text of the quick reply message.

For example, if the quick reply message is "Yes, show me!", the follower can tap the message button to send the exact message "Yes, show me!".

Length limit: 20 characters.| #|quick_action_type {+Conditional}|string|Required when `interaction` is `QUICK_ACTION`.

The type of quick action.

Enum values:
  • `SHOP`: Shop. To let followers browse your products. You must be a TikTok Shop seller or creator with active listings.
  • `JOIN_GROUP`: Join group. To let followers join your group chat to stay engaged. You must be a TikTok Shop seller or have 10K+ followers.
| ``` ### Example #### Update a welcome message ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/message/auto_message/update/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "business_id": "{{business_id}}", "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}", "auto_message_type": "WELCOME_MESSAGE", "welcome_message": { "content": "{{content}}" } }' (/code) ``` #### Update a suggested question ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/message/auto_message/update/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "business_id": "{{business_id}}", "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}", "auto_message_type": "SUGGESTED_QUESTION", "suggested_question": { "question": "{{question}}", "answer":"{{answer}}" } }' (/code) ``` #### Update a chat prompt ```xcodeblock (code curl http) curl --location --request POST 'https://business-api.tiktok.com/open_api/v1.3/business/message/auto_message/update/' \ --header 'Access-Token: {{Access-Token}}' \ --header 'Content-Type: application/json' \ --data '{ "business_id": "{{business_id}}", "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}", "auto_message_type": "CHAT_PROMPT", "chat_prompt": { "title": "{{title}}", "content":"{{content}}" } }' (/code) ``` ## Response ``` xtable |Field{30%}|Type{15%}|Description{55%}| |---|---|---| |code |number|Response code. For the complete list of response codes and descriptions, see [Appendix-Return Code](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097). | |message|string|Response message. For details, see [Appendix - Return Codes](https://business-api.tiktok.com/portal/docs?id=1737172488964097).| |request_id |string|The log ID of a request, which uniquely identifies the request. | |data |object|Returned data.| #| auto_message | object | Information about the automatic message. | ##| auto_message_id | string | The ID of the automatic message. | ``` ### Example ```xcodeblock (code Success-Response http) HTTPS/1.1 200 OK { "code": 0, "message": "OK", "request_id": "{{request_id}}", "data": { "auto_message": { "auto_message_id": "{{auto_message_id}}" } } } (/code) ```
